flashcard_questions.q: Help given by one country, organisation or group to another, usually to support development or respond to emergencies.
Aid given directly by one government to the government of another country, often with conditions attached.
Aid given by governments to international organisations like the United Nations or World Bank, which then distribute it to countries in need.
UK bilateral aid to _____ peaked at £421 million in 2010 but has since fallen to around £91 million by 2021 — reflecting India’s growing ability to fund its own development
